title: An additive adjunction transposes a specified cone square
statement: Let E and E-prime be preadditive categories with binary biproducts, and L:E to E-prime left adjoint to R:E-prime to E, both additive. Use the termwise adjunction ac on integer-indexed cochain complexes [lem-weil-pbc-termwise-adjunction-homotopy]. For p:P to Q, t:A to B, alpha:P to R(A), beta:Q to R(B), and a specified homotopy H:p beta homotopic to alpha R(t), put a=ac.symm(alpha), b=ac.symm(beta). There exists H-prime:L(p) b homotopic to a t such that Cone.mapOfHomotopy(H-prime) equals the inverse additive cone comparison Cone(L(p)) to L(Cone(p)), followed by ac.symm of Cone.mapOfHomotopy(H) followed by the inverse comparison Cone(R(t)) to R(Cone(t)). The equality is of actual chain maps, not just their homotopy classes.

source.place: Tag 014P (mapping cone formulas), combined with the termwise additive adjunction.

proof.text: Apply L to H and postcompose with the termwise counit. Prepend the left-naturality equality for the transpose of beta and append counit naturality for t; this constructs the required homotopy H-prime.

In every degree, compare the two chain maps after the cone injections. Expand mapOfHomotopy, the additive cone comparison, and the transpose as L(map) followed by the counit. Functoriality, additivity, and counit naturality identify the diagonal and off-diagonal components, retaining the specified homotopy and its sign.

lean.statement:
theorem additiveAdjunction_cone_square
    {E : Type u} {E' : Type u'} [Category.{v} E] [Category.{v'} E']
    [Preadditive E] [Preadditive E'] [HasBinaryBiproducts E] [HasBinaryBiproducts E']
    {L : E ⥤ E'} {R : E' ⥤ E} [L.Additive] [R.Additive] (adj : L ⊣ R)
    {P Q : CochainComplex E ℤ} {A B : CochainComplex E' ℤ}
    (p : P ⟶ Q) (t : A ⟶ B)
    (α : P ⟶ (R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj A)
    (β : Q ⟶ (R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj B)
    (H : Homotopy (p ≫ β) (α ≫ (R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map t)) :
    let ac := adj.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let a := (ac.homEquiv _ _).symm α
    let b := (ac.homEquiv _ _).symm β
    ∃ H' : Homotopy ((L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map p ≫ b) (a ≫ t),
      mappingCone.mapOfHomotopy H' =
        (mappingCone.mapHomologicalComplexIso p L).inv ≫
          (ac.homEquiv _ _).symm
            (mappingCone.mapOfHomotopy H ≫
              (mappingCone.mapHomologicalComplexIso t R).inv)
